simple.label: Simple project
simple.description: For a small website or application that needs a direct, guided ContextPack-to-Codex handoff.
safeguards: inspect, preview, approval, apply and verify remain separate

mature.label: Mature project
mature.description: For an established application with more architecture, environments, deployment, data or authentication context to preserve.
projectSignals: existing CI/CD, operational records or production state
safeguards: exact local Git identity and update-readiness checks
maintainer, security, CI and module-authoring records must be present
project complexity never authorizes production or account changes
